name: GES follow-up (3 weeks)
description: Our playbook after the first call: proposal email, then a follow-up email every other day and a call twice a week. No reply in 3 weeks: switch to another contact. Any reply stops the sequence and goes to the owner to handle by hand.

steps.subject: Sponsorship proposal: {{fest}} x {{company}}
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Thank you for taking my call today. As promised, I have attached our sponsorship proposal for {{fest}}.

The fest draws 20,000 to 25,000+ footfall, with 120K+ social reach and a million+ media impressions. Partners get stage branding, speaker slots, stalls and direct access to students.

The {{package}} package could fit {{company}} well. Would you have 20 minutes this week to discuss it?

Best regards,
{{sender}}
Corporate & Media Relations, {{fest}}

steps.subject: Re: Sponsorship proposal: {{fest}} x {{company}}
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Just checking that the proposal reached you. Happy to walk you through it on a quick call or adjust the package to what {{company}} wants to achieve.

Best,
{{sender}}

steps.subject: Follow-up call
steps.body: Ask if they saw the proposal; find the decision maker and their timeline.

steps.subject: {{company}} at {{fest}}: a few ideas
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

A few ways partners like {{company}} have used the fest: a hands-on workshop for students, a speaker slot in a panel, or category exclusivity on the main stage.

If any of these is interesting, I can share a short plan.

Best,
{{sender}}

steps.subject: Reach and footfall from our last edition
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Sharing last edition's numbers: 20,000 to 25,000+ footfall, 120K+ social reach and 20+ media partners. Happy to send the branding report from last year as well.

Best,
{{sender}}

steps.subject: Partner slots for {{fest}}
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

We are finalising partners for {{fest}} over the next few weeks. Would it help if I held the {{package}} slot for {{company}} while you review?

Best,
{{sender}}

steps.subject: Follow-up call
steps.body: Ask about budget timing and who signs off.

steps.subject: Would a short call help?
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I know inboxes get busy. If a 15-minute call is easier than email, just reply with a time that suits you.

Best,
{{sender}}

steps.subject: Follow-up call
steps.body: Last call attempt with this contact this week.

steps.subject: Last note from the {{fest}} team
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

I will not keep filling your inbox. If someone else at {{company}} handles partnerships or brand events, could you point me to them?

Thank you,
{{sender}}

steps.subject: Final call
steps.body: Ask for the right person; if no answer, prepare to switch contact on day 21.
